usedFor: AddressZen checks contact details with “Validate Email”, “Verify Address” and “Validate Phone Number” before they reach your records.

bestTemplate.name: “Verify Address” in AddressZen
bestTemplate.why: It checks and standardizes a US address against USPS data and returns delivery details.

watchOut: “Validate Email” reports whether an address is deliverable, disposable, role-based or free, so decide what to do with each result.
